basics.description: **Note:** Please refer to the following before installing the solution: • Review the solution [Release Notes](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Solutions/FullHunt/ReleaseNotes.md) • There may be [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing. The [FullHunt](https://fullhunt.io) solution for Microsoft Sentinel brings your external attack surface into Microsoft Sentinel so you can monitor, hunt and respond to changes in it. **Data connectors** ingest FullHunt attack surface alerts (new subdomains, exposed ports, DNS and certificate changes, discovered vulnerabilities), vulnerabilities, certificate-derived domains, suggested domains, and, with the FullHunt Dark Web Monitoring module, typosquatting and potential phishing domains. **Playbooks** enrich incidents with FullHunt host, domain, IP, passive DNS, WHOIS and vulnerability intelligence (CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, exploits, advisories). Deploy the FullHunt custom connector before the playbooks. Playbook lookups consume FullHunt credits. **Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:** This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/) state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs: a. [Azure Monitor Logs: DCR-based Custom Logs](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/logs-ingestion-api-overview) b. [Codeless Connector Framework (CCF)](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/create-codeless-connector) c. [Azure Logic Apps custom connectors](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/logic-apps/custom-connector-overview) **Data Connectors:** 6, **Custom Azure Logic Apps Connectors:** 1, **Playbooks:** 5 [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)

options.text: This solution installs the Playbook templates to help implement your Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR) operations. After installing the solution, these will be deployed under Playbook Templates in the Automation blade in Microsoft Sentinel. They can be configured and managed from the Manage solution view in Content Hub.
